resolved_conflicts.explanation: Treated as the destroyed Bald Mountain on the Idaho Fire Lookouts page, because that is the only source in this record that gives a history with this status. The Big Baldy lookout (NHLR, Latah County, rented) is listed by Idaho Fire Lookouts at 5,334 feet, against 5,036 feet for this page's tower, and the story presents it separately without deciding identity. The record's Boise County and Boise National Forest fields come from a page that gives no history, and its coordinates are about 1.7 km from Big Baldy. Editor to confirm which site this record means before publication.

notes_for_editor: Identity problem. (1) This record's source pages are idaholookouts.weebly.com/bald-mountain2.html (a Boise County listing, 9N-5E-29, with no history; its page text is only a directory and a climbing-guide line) and the Idaho Fire Lookouts page. The Idaho page is the same one us-id-bald-mountain-4 uses (Clearwater County, Clearwater Timber Protective Association), and the two stories share the same history. Probably the same tower; consider merging. (2) The record's coordinates (47.0335, -116.59406) are about 1.7 km from the standing Big Baldy tower in us-id-bald-mountain-3 (47.03194, -116.57194), which is rented today. (3) The 1987/1988 reader comment conflicts with the 1972 destruction date. (4) A web search for Boise National Forest Bald Mountain history found only a news feature about a 1908 lookout on a Bald Mountain now called Thorn Creek Lookout, with no county. It is not used, as it is only a search snippet. Recommend holding publication until the editor confirms the site. Fact-check 2026-10-10: the story no longer says 'do not confuse'; that was an editor's note, not a sourced fact. It gives both elevations instead (5,036 feet here, 5,334 feet Big Baldy). Points for the editor: the NHLR history of the Latah County tower (cabin built 1913, L-4 cab on a 50-foot pole tower in 1938, 41-foot tower built 1960) is close to this page's history (cabin 1914, 50-foot pole tower with L-4 cab by 1933), though the dates differ. The 1923 line on the page reads 'Observation tower ith log cabin' (typo on the page); the word 'pole' is not on that line and was removed from the story and this record.
